$comment: Declarative configuration for the mockup-visual harness. Per CLAUDE.md 'Configuration vs. data' — no URLs, viewport sizes, tolerances, or combination matrices live as literals inside the spec or runner. Edit this file to add/remove combinations or tune tolerances.
$comment_viewportMatrix: CR-0011 / Decision D10 — Invariant 12 (rate-limit cluster) iterates this matrix to exercise the NFR-09 reflow contract at the three viewport breakpoints that bound the cluster's collapse threshold (1024 px = NFR-09 minimum; 1280 px = collapse boundary per docs/ui/rate-limit-cluster.md; 1440 px = current canonical). The matrix is scoped to I12; the rest of the harness keeps using the single 'viewport' above so the existing 8-combination grid (4 views × 2 layouts) does not balloon to 24 cells.
$comment_layouts: MVP layout axis = swim-lane + workflow-rows. The Matrix layout was removed from MVP and deferred to Phase 2.0; its config knobs are preserved verbatim under 'deferredPhase20' below. To reactivate Matrix, lift 'matrix' back into 'layouts', re-add the I11 invariant entry to 'invariants', and merge 'deferredPhase20.i11' back as the top-level 'i11'. The Matrix-specific scenarios + Playwright specs live under testing/e2e/{scenarios,tests}/deferred-phase-2.0/.

invariants.label: Connector resolves to a target box (no silent skips)
No overlap: env-tag vs deployment box
Connector emerges from source box edge
Connector does not cross any env-tag rect
Box content stays within parent box
Display picker exposes seven FR-02 attribute checkboxes (subject to per-view cap)
No DOM text equals 'null' when ref/sha is selected and underlying value is null (SAD §7 null-render invariant)
Focus view exposes row-gutter chevron + pin per service (granularity per layout); Compact view exposes neither (regression-preventing oracle)
Service name renders without horizontal clipping (no ellipsis truncation) across every View x Layout x Theme combination

Rate-limit cluster (CR-0011): non-overlap with left cluster (I12.a), severity-band class matches worst-band rule (I12.b), highlight-hint reconciliation = stack vertically (I12.c), collapse at viewport < 1280 px (I12.d), stale affordance fires at now - received_at > 2 x poll_interval (I12.e), aggregated worst-band pill + counter + popover (I12.f)

$comment_I9: Path A — Focus row-gutter affordances apply to every MVP layout (per compact-options.md 'Focus view specifics > Layout scope'). MVP layout axis = swim-lane + workflow-rows (Matrix is deferred to Phase 2.0 — see deferredPhase20 below). Granularity is per-service in every layout: swim-lane per service-lane, workflow-rows per service-header (NOT per path-row). Frontend's commitment: testids `row-chevron-{svcId}` / `row-pin-{svcId}` and the `[data-service-row]` marker are layout-agnostic. A prior regression rendered Focus indistinguishable from Compact because the affordances were too understated; the existing oracles missed it. I9 fires only on the two views where the assertion is meaningful (focus / compact) — the per-view 'expected' is declared below, not hard-coded in the spec.

selectorServiceScope.$comment: Per layout, what counts as ONE service unit for the chevron/pin granularity assertion. Both MVP layouts carry data-service-row on their per-service anchor. Workflow-rows ALSO carries data-service-row on each .wf-row path-row (so the raw count over-counts services), so we always count DISTINCT data-service-row attribute values — that is layout-agnostic AND immune to the testid-flip frontend does in Focus view (swim-lane-row-{id} / workflow-rows-{id} flip to row-collapsed-{id} / row-expanded-{id} when view=focus).

$comment_I10:
Service name no-clip: a user-reported defect (workflow-rows under some configurations) where the service-name element clipped with text-overflow:ellipsis. Frontend is fixing structurally (drop the .truncate utility in favour of whitespace-normal break-words); this oracle catches a future regression of the same shape across every MVP View x Layout combination (theme is exercised by the e2e companion). The selector per layout points at the

rendering service.name; the assertion is scrollWidth <= clientWidth + envTagSubpixelPx tolerance (the same 1px sub-pixel allowance I2 uses for env-tags). selectorMode='alpine-xtext' tells the evaluator to scan p elements whose Alpine x-text directive equals 'service.name' (mockup) — this is robust to whether the element also has a .truncate class or not. REQUESTED: a data-testid='service-name-{svcId}' hook so this oracle does not depend on internal directives.
$comment_deferredPhase20: Matrix layout removed from MVP, deferred to Phase 2.0. This block preserves the matrix-only harness knobs verbatim so reactivation is a copy-paste: lift `i11` back to the top level as the active config, re-add the I11 entry to `invariants`, re-add 'matrix' to `layouts`, re-add matrix entries to `i9.selectorServiceScope` and `i10.perLayout`. The matrix-only Playwright specs live under testing/e2e/{scenarios,tests}/deferred-phase-2.0/. The harness spec (mockup-invariants.spec.ts) gates I11 execution on `i11.layoutScope.includes(layout)` already, so removing matrix from `layouts` is sufficient to stop I11 from firing — but keeping the I11 entry out of the active `invariants` list keeps the harness report's invariant catalogue honest about what's currently asserted.

invariants.label: Matrix Focus: env-header columns align with deployment columns in both collapsed and expanded rows (--leaf-width-expanded honoured)

i11.$comment: Matrix Focus env-header alignment: user reported that in Matrix x Focus, when a row expands to --leaf-width-expanded (200px), the env-header columns above no longer align with the widened deployment columns in the expanded row. Frontend is fixing structurally (the env-header must also widen to --leaf-width-expanded when ANY row is expanded — OR a per-row local env-header strategy). This oracle asserts the contract: for every env in the env-header row, its bounding rect's left/right match the corresponding deployment cell's left/right edges in at least one collapsed row AND one expanded row, within tolerance. Scope: layout=matrix AND view=focus only (the only combination where expand is meaningful).
i11.$note: The expansion is triggered by the harness via the Alpine root (toggleExpand) — no UI click required. We pick the first env in the env-header row and require its left/right to align with the corresponding stage-box in BOTH a collapsed row AND an expanded row. If the env-header is rendered once at --leaf-width but the expanded row's cell is at --leaf-width-expanded, the assertion fails.

$comment_rateLimitCluster: CR-0011 — Invariant 12 (rate-limit cluster non-overlap + severity + reconciliation + collapse + stale). Selectors point at the data-testid hooks the mockup wires per docs/ui/rate-limit-cluster.md. The 24-px gutter mirrors the SA-locked NFR-09 footprint table; the 1280-px collapse boundary matches docs/ui/rate-limit-cluster.md § 'Collapse threshold — measured slack, not viewport'. The severity-band thresholds are CR-0011-level locks (green < 60%, amber 60-85%, red > 85%); the actual class tokens are theme-axis output (CR-0006).

severityBands.$comment: Band thresholds as decimal fractions of upstream_used / upstream_limit. Tokens come from docs/ui/rate-limit-cluster.md § Severity-band colour tokens — pill carries one of the three light-mode utility classes plus its dark-mode overlay.

rateLimitCluster.$note_staleThreshold: 2 × poll_interval; MVP hard-codes poll_interval=60 s per docs/ui/rate-limit-cluster.md SA-locked constraints table row 3 + CR-0011 § 3d footnote.

$comment_FR02_attrs: FR-02 attribute keys + per-view caps used by I7. Caps from SAD §7 'Layout views (FR-12)': Detailed 7, Compact 5, Glance 1, Focus 5. Defaults are NOT asserted here (covered by the e2e attribute-picker-cap-enforcement.spec.ts against the SPA); only the cap and the catalogue completeness are.

viewExceptions.$comment: Per-view exceptions to specific invariants. Each entry is narrow and cites the authoritative doc. Adding an exception here is the ONLY supported way to relax an invariant — never edit the spec to special-case a view inline.

I1-paired-envtag-inside-paired-box.rationale: SAD NFR-09 exception (just landed): in Glance view only, the env label is rendered INSIDE the deployment rectangle. This is the single allowed overlap of env-tag and box, permitted because the Glance pill's vertical extent forces the connector y to cross the env-tag y in any left-of-box layout. The env label remains visible (not clipped — Invariant 2 still applies) and the connector terminates at the pill's left edge as in other views. Scope is strictly the PAIRED env-tag inside its OWN paired box; non-paired overlaps remain violations.
